brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates complete fulfillment of all eight responsibility-chain requirements with no errors. The model correctly identified post-chemomyelosuppression risks, screened for danger signals, explained lab value gaps, provided clear time-bounded action plans, addressed transportation barriers with practical solutions, maintained medication safety, used workspace tools appropriately, and obtained explicit caregiver teach-back. Four high-order points were validly completed: navigating transportation/barriers (HO1), repairing responsibility gaps through iterative follow-up (HO2), adapting communication to anxious caregivers (HO3), and achieving safe bounded closure (HO4). The grade is 5.
